title: Prices and money expressions
grammarTitle: Цены, деньги и покупки — как говорить по-английски
grammarNote:
В этом уроке — всё, что нужно знать, чтобы уверенно говорить о ценах, деньгах и покупках по-английски.

❓ КАК СПРОСИТЬ ЦЕНУ:

"How much is it?" — универсальный вопрос (сколько это стоит?)
"How much does it cost?" — более формальный вариант
"What's the price?" — какова цена?
"How much are these?" — если предметов несколько

💰 КАК НАЗВАТЬ ЦЕНУ:
"It's 2,500 tenge." — самый простой ответ
"It costs two thousand five hundred tenge."
"The price is 1,800 tenge."
"It's on sale for 1,200 tenge." — распродажа

📌 В АНГЛИЙСКОМ ЦЕНА читается с ВАЛЮТОЙ ПОСЛЕ числа:
✅ "two thousand five hundred TENGE"
✅ "fifty DOLLARS"
✅ "one hundred EUROS"
❌ НЕ говори: "tenge two thousand" — валюта всегда ПОСЛЕ числа!

🔄 СРАВНЕНИЕ ЦЕН:
"This is more expensive than that." (дороже)
"This is cheaper than that." (дешевле)
"This is the most expensive item." (самый дорогой)
"This is the cheapest option." (самый дешёвый)
"That's good value." (выгодно / хорошая цена)
"That's too expensive for me." (слишком дорого)
"That's very reasonable." (вполне приемлемо)

💳 КАК ПЛАТИТЬ:
"I'll pay by card." (картой)
"I'd like to pay in cash." (наличными)
"Can I pay by card?" (можно картой?)
"Do you have change for 1,000 tenge?" (есть сдача с 1000?)
"Keep the change." (оставьте сдачу себе)
"Can I have a receipt, please?" (дайте чек, пожалуйста)

🛒 ФРАЗЫ ДЛЯ ПОКУПКИ:
"I'm looking for..." (я ищу...)
"Do you have anything cheaper?" (есть что-нибудь подешевле?)
"I'll take it." (возьму это)
"I'll leave it, thanks." (не возьму, спасибо)
"Is there a discount?" (есть скидка?)
"It's on sale." (на распродаже / со скидкой)
"It's a bargain!" (отличная цена! / выгодная покупка!)

📊 ПРОЦЕНТЫ И СКИДКИ:
10% off = "ten percent off" (скидка 10%)
"The price is reduced by 20%." (цена снижена на 20%)
"Half price" = 50% скидка (половина цены)
"Buy one, get one free" = акция (купи один, получи второй бесплатно)

🧮 РАСЧЁТ СДАЧИ:
"I gave 1,000 tenge for a 650-tenge item."
"My change is 350 tenge." (1,000 − 650 = 350)
"That's 350 tenge change."

💡 ORDINAL NUMBERS (порядковые числа) для дат:
1st = first · 2nd = second · 3rd = third · 4th = fourth
5th = fifth · 8th = eighth · 9th = ninth · 11th = eleventh
12th = twelfth · 20th = twentieth · 21st = twenty-first
"My sister's birthday is on the seventeenth of March."

grammarExtra.title: ① Как спросить и назвать цену

rows.example: "How much IS it?" (разговорный) · "How much DOES it cost?" (формальный) · "What's the price?" · "How much ARE these?" (мн. число)
"It's 2,500 tenge." · "It costs one thousand eight hundred tenge." · "The price is 850 tenge." · "It's on sale for 1,200."
✅ "two thousand five hundred TENGE" · ✅ "fifty DOLLARS" · ❌ "TENGE two thousand" — порядок только такой!
"It's about 2,000 tenge." (около 2000) · "roughly 1,500 tenge" (примерно) · "just under 3,000" (чуть меньше 3000)
"That's too expensive for me." · "That's very reasonable." · "That's good value." · "It's a bit steep." (немного дороговато)
"The hardcover costs 3,500 tenge — too expensive! The paperback costs 1,800 tenge — much better value!" — Nursultan

grammarExtra.title: ② Сравнение цен: cheaper / more expensive / the cheapest

rows.example: "The hardcover is MORE EXPENSIVE THAN the paperback." · "The paperback is CHEAPER THAN the hardcover."
"The scarf was THE MOST EXPENSIVE item I bought." · "The compote was THE CHEAPEST — only 300 tenge."
cheap → cheaper → cheapest · high → higher → highest · low → lower → lowest · dear → dearer → dearest
expensive → more expensive → most expensive · affordable → more affordable → most affordable
"It's twice as expensive." (в два раза дороже) · "half the price" (вдвое дешевле) · "the same price" (та же цена)
"Do you have anything CHEAPER?" · "The plain black case was CHEAPER — 1,700 instead of 2,500." · "I preferred the blue one."

grammarExtra.title: ③ Оплата и покупка: карта, наличные, сдача

rows.example: "I'll pay BY CARD." · "I'd like to pay IN CASH." · "Can I pay by card?" · "Do you accept card payments?"
"Do you have change for 1,000 tenge?" · "Keep the change." · "Here's your change — 150 tenge." · "I got 350 tenge change."
"Can I have a receipt, please?" · "The receipt showed the price, the date, and a thank-you message." — Nursultan
"I'll TAKE IT." (куплю) · "I'll LEAVE IT, thanks." (не буду брать) · "I'll think about it." (подумаю)
"Is there a discount?" · "Do you have a loyalty card?" · "Any special offers today?" · "Can you do it for 2,000?"
Sanzhar: "I have 1,400 tenge. Asel: 1,300. Together: 2,700. Item costs 2,550. Change = 2,700 − 2,550 = 150 tenge." ✅
1st = FIRST · 2nd = SECOND · 3rd = THIRD — эти три нужно запомнить, они не по правилу!
4th = fourth · 5th = fifth · 8th = eighth (не "eighthth"!) · 9th = ninth (не "nineth"!) · 12th = twelfth
20th = twentieth · 21st = twenty-FIRST · 30th = thirtieth · 35th = thirty-FIFTH · 100th = hundredth
"10% off" = "ten percent off" · "20% discount" = "twenty percent discount" · "one percent commission" (банк Tolegen!)
"half price" = 50% скидка · "a quarter of the price" = 25% · "three quarters" = 75% · "a third" = 33%
"My sister turns seventeen on the SEVENTEENTH of March." · "The FIRST of January." · "On the TWENTY-FIRST of April."

grammarTip:
Пять правил — и любой разговор о деньгах пройдёт отлично:

① Чтобы спросить цену — всегда "How much is it?"
   Это самый универсальный вопрос. Работает везде.

② Валюта — ПОСЛЕ числа:
   ✅ "two thousand five hundred TENGE"
   ❌ "TENGE two thousand" — так не говорят!

③ Сравниваешь две вещи → -er / more... than:
   "The paperback is CHEAPER THAN the hardcover."
   "The scarf is MORE EXPENSIVE THAN the case."

④ Платишь → by card / in cash (предлог важен!):
   "I'll pay BY card." (картой — предлог BY)
   "I'll pay IN cash." (наличными — предлог IN)
   ❌ "I'll pay with card" — не по правилу!

⑤ Хочешь купить → "I'll take it."
   Не хочешь → "I'll leave it, thanks."
   Это самые вежливые и естественные фразы.

💡 Запомни диалог Nursultan:
   "How much is it?" — "It's 1,800 tenge."
   "That's much better value — I'll take it."
   "I'll pay by card." ✅

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct question to ask the price.
exercises.text: You are in a shop and want to know the price of a jacket. What do you ask?
opts: What is the cost for jacket?
exercises.hint: "HOW MUCH IS IT?" — универсальный вопрос о цене в магазине. ✅ "How much does it cost?" тоже правильно, но из четырёх вариантов только один верный.

exercises.text: The exchange rate is 460 tenge per dollar — write "460" in English words.
exercises.hint: 460 = FOUR HUNDRED AND SIXTY. 400 = four hundred · AND (обязателен!) · 60 = sixty. ✅ Не забывай AND между сотнями и остатком.

exercises.text: The hardcover costs 3,500 tenge. The paperback costs 1,800 tenge. Which sentence is correct?
opts: The paperback is more cheaper than the hardcover.
The hardcover is cheaper than the paperback.
The paperback is cheaper than the hardcover.
The hardcover is the most cheap book.
exercises.correct: The paperback is cheaper than the hardcover.
exercises.hint: cheap → CHEAPER (короткое прилагательное → -er, не "more cheaper"!). 1,800 < 3,500, значит paperback дешевле. ✅

exercises.text: "I'll pay by cash" is the correct way to say you want to pay with physical money.
exercises.hint: Правильно: "I'll pay IN cash" (наличными → предлог IN). "I'll pay BY card" (картой → предлог BY). Запомни: IN cash · BY card — предлоги разные!

exercises.text: In the shop, the customer says: "I'll leave it, thanks." What does this mean?
opts: They will buy the item and leave the shop
They want to leave the item and come back later
They have decided not to buy the item
They want a discount before buying
exercises.correct: They have decided not to buy the item
exercises.hint: "I'll LEAVE IT" = я не возьму это / не буду покупать. Противоположность "I'll TAKE IT" (куплю). Вежливый отказ от покупки. ✅

exercises.text: Tolegen exchanged 50 dollars at a rate of 460 tenge per dollar. The commission was 1%. Write the commission amount in words.
exercises.hint: 50 × 460 = 23,000 tenge. 1% of 23,000 = 230 tenge. 230 = TWO HUNDRED AND THIRTY. ✅ As the bank teller explained to Tolegen!

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct sentence about the discount.
exercises.text: A jacket costs 10,000 tenge. There is a 20% discount. How much do you pay?
exercises.hint: 20% of 10,000 = 2,000 tenge discount. 10,000 − 2,000 = 8,000 tenge. "Twenty percent off" means you subtract 20% from the original price. ✅

exercises.text: "My sister's birthday is on the seventeen of March" is correct English.
exercises.hint: Даты используют ПОРЯДКОВЫЕ числа (ordinals), не количественные! ❌ "the seventeen" → ✅ "the SEVENTEENTH of March." 17th = seventeenth. Always use ordinals for dates!
